title: The Psychotron
overview:
Track Down the Mystery of the Psychotron, Russia's Latest Secret Weapon!

CIA Director Darin Bird has ordered you to conduct a confidential investigation into an incident believed to be an inside job at the CIA. The Psychotron, which the United States purchased from the former Soviet Union, has mysteriously vanished in the crash of a CIA plane, and it has become the greatest threat to national security. The nation's future rests on the player's shoulders. To solve this case, the player must carefully question suspects, find clues, and confront suspicious figures.

- A thrilling adventure game in which the player, at the CIA's request, tracks the whereabouts of a Russian secret weapon!
- CIA or KGB? A spy mystery where one mystery leads to another, with one powerful scene after another!
- Koichi Hamada, known as "Hamako," takes on his first voice acting role, alongside a cast of famous voice actors including Kenji Utsumi, in a fully Japanese dub!

ロシアの最新秘密兵器サイコトロンの謎を追え！

ダリン・バードCIA長官は、CIAの内部工作と思われるある事件の内密な調査をあなたに命じた。旧ソ連から米国が購入したサイコトロンがCIA機の事故により不可解にも消えてしまい、国家の安全を脅かす最大の脅威となった。国の将来はプレイヤーの肩にかかっているのだ。この事件を解決するために、プレイヤーは慎重に容疑者を尋問し、手掛かりを見つけ、そして疑わしい人物と対決しなければならない。

★プレイヤーがCIAに依頼され、ロシアの秘密兵器の行方を追う、スリル溢れるアドベンチャー・ゲーム！
★CIAか、KGBか、謎が謎を呼ぶスパイ・ミステリー、迫力あるシーンの連続！
★ハマコーこと浜田幸一氏が声優に初挑戦のほか、内海賢二氏など有名声優陣による完全日本語吹替！
